lane: DZ-EDGE v2 (count-holding PRUNE + parent-sparse damage-zone refill)
hypothesis: Blind geothermal systems localise at damage-zone margins and off-catalogue structural positions, not on mapped catalogue traces. At fixed count ~37,654 and ~3 px spacing, deleting dots <=10 px of the catalogue and refilling into damage-zone cells that are also far from any parent dot (under-explored off-catalogue territory) raises per-dot truth credit (T) and cuts redundant mass (S-M), lifting pooled DTI over R0's 0.2778 CLAIM.
mechanism: DTI = T / (alpha*T + alpha*(S-M) + beta*|G|), alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, R=300 m triangular kernel. Sparse ~3 px dots maximise T per truth pixel; redundant dots pay alpha per unit mass. Relocating dots from catalogue-proximal to damage-zone/parent-sparse cells targets blind truth without adding mass.
non_fault_mimic_process: Distributed microseismicity / background damage unrelated to geothermal upflow could produce damage-zone dots that do not coincide with blind fault truth; the SGMC off-catalogue control would expose this (requires external SGMC raster, absent - no public mirror).
